last_summary: replication-watch run 7 (gear 1, `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash`, `letta model get` @08:05:57Z; no quota error, no gear-2). THREE RECORDS, ZERO LENR — a deliberate counter to this lane's own 8-of-36 (22%) LENR share flagged in Issue 15 — and two of the three open domains the Yard had never touched (alternative optics / colour therapy; the Goethean picture-forming method). (1) COPPER CHLORIDE CRYSTALLISATION, strongest entry this rail has: Guglielmetti/Doesburg/Scherr/Martin/Baumgartner/Tournier (Hiscia, Arlesheim + Witten/Herdecke + Bern), Scientific Reports 16:7506, 24 Feb 2026 (10.1038/s41598-026-41081-6) — a pre-designed SENSITIVITY LADDER that could have failed at its hardest rung: 6 systematic control experiments came back FLAT (no main effect for the tested parameter in any of 7 image variables; no batch effect = chamber equivalence), then 12 Verum experiments on 288 mistletoe fingerprints: 7/7 variables separated two subspecies (l250, Cohen's d 1.75), 4/7 separated apple- from oak-grown (d 0.57, only in batch 2204), 2/7 separated hand- from machine-blended (d 0.20-0.28). The third is the only test not re-detecting documented chemistry — a metabolomics study found NOTHING between the two blends — and the authors call its systems-level reading `speculative`, naming high-shear physical/structural change as an alternative. Filed medium for METHOD SENSITIVITY, low beyond: tests discrimination, not mechanism; touches neither timing, place, nor the formative claim dossier 013 exists to test. (2) BIOFIELD, first practitioner-mediated entry on that rail (the two 09-21 cards are a device and an object): Delorme, Cohen et al. (MD Anderson human EEG + Baylor mouse EEG), IBRO Neuroscience Reports 21, 28 May 2026 (10.1016/j.ibneur.2026.05.011; PMID 42305856, PMC13266234) — pre-registered (osf.io/n2gwj), double-blind to mouse type, 24 sessions, ONE Bengston-method practitioner vs ONE sham, 64-ch human + 3-ch mouse EEG. The measure nearest the claim came back NULL: no spectral-power change in mice. Every significant row in their band table is baseline-vs-treatment (theta 130.83 / alpha 179.99 / beta 86.90 / gamma 65.33, all p<0.01); CANCER-VS-CONTROL AND THE INTERACTION ARE NOT SIGNIFICANT ON ANY BAND; both BT and sham shifted vs baseline, so the authors will not attribute it to a biofield mechanism. The cancer endpoint is in a SEPARATE unpublished paper. One practitioner per arm — the therapist-EEG signature rests on one man. Filed low. (3) METAL COLOUR LIGHT THERAPY (Altmaier's metal-oxide glass panels, the anthroposophic coloured-light method), first record in that family: Streffer/Thronicke/Schad et al., Havelhoehe Berlin, ISfAM 2026 abstract 26isfam067 (10.3205/26isfam067, 12 Jun 2026) — 47/60 breast-cancer patients, nine 45-min sessions, fatigue 61->51 (p=0.001) and insomnia 69->49 (p=0.0003), holding at 3 months. NO CONTROL ARM, self-report only, meeting abstract. Filed low; the group's own protocol paper named the missing control two years earlier. LIVE WATCH ITEM: LUCIA 2.0 (DRKS00040901), registered 13 Jul 2026, `Recruiting ongoing`, randomized but WAITLIST-controlled, primary endpoint fatigue — controls time, not expectancy, so light-vs-sitting stays open. Also carried: the Goetheanum's own 3-year basic-research project on metal-based coloured light (from 2025, Rang/Arncken/Monden), and the neighbouring randomized coloured-light trial that used HRV as an objective readout (Frontiers in Psychology 2026, blue light: anxiety down, RMSSD up). REBUILD — and this is the run's real lesson: a narrow sparse cone (navigator/, synthesis/, library_feed.json, build_library_feed.py) produced a feed of 963 KB against the published 27.65 MB, because `seam` is built from index_io.load() and index_shards/ was outside the cone — seal collapsed 18,169,924 -> 135 bytes, with archive_entries, meta_counts, the rare/random drawers and the news strip all downstream of the same index and NONE of them on the never-regress guard list. The listed guards all fired correctly, so the run looked healthy in its own log while having quietly lost 27 MB. Adding `index_shards/**`, `index_io.py`, `archive-graph.json` restored the feed to 27,649,129 B with seam whole. THREE THINGS NO CONE FIX REACHES: `atsuyskovsky_books` emptied and `library.book5_complete` went True->null (that section gates on the living-library mount, absent here), and the `found` daily drawer vanished because drawers are drawn from latest_finds BEFORE that section's never-regress guard runs. AND THEN THE FIND THAT MATTERS MORE THAN MY OWN BUILD: main moved while this run was in flight and origin/main (`dcb1fd93e`, drunvalo's translation-QC report) had ALREADY been given a degraded feed by another lane — stamped 08:06:22Z, one minute after my own build, and degraded the same way: atsuyskovsky_books [] and library.book5_complete True->null, the `found` daily drawer gone, and THREE OF EIGHT news items missing (the Atsyukovsky Book 5 milestone plus both paradigm signals, whose 23 `paradigm-signal` entries are right there in synthesis/synthesis_index.json). The live site has been serving without the Book 5 card and the convergence/paradigm chips since 08:06Z, and NO CONE FIX REACHES IT — those sections gate on the living-library mount, which no sandbox has. The only real fix is a rebuild from a member that has the mount, diffed section by section before it pushes. PUBLISHED ARTIFACT: origin/main + the freshly computed `practical` block (54 quests / 63 dossiers / 39 validations) + library.validations 36->39 + the three sections the other lane's degraded build dropped, each restored from the immediately preceding published revision (atsuyskovsky_books, library.book5_complete, library.counter_snapshot.atsuyskovsky_books, news). Diff vs origin/main = 57 insertions / 6 deletions, every line intended. The Book 5 material was CONFIRMED PRESENT before restoring it, not assumed: sources/atsyukovsky/Book5_full_translation.md = 521,582 bytes in the tree (its chunks/manifest.json is living-library-only, which is exactly why that card can vanish on a sandbox). LEFT UNRESTORED, deliberately: the `found` daily drawer (drawn from latest_finds BEFORE that section's never-regress guard runs; cosmetic, re-picks daily, self-healing). `daily_counts.json` NOT committed — the degraded build appended a snapshot with `docs: null` and the HUD compares against it. INSTRUMENT NOTES: bake_stats.py is the last call in main() and sits outside a narrow cone — the feed is written BEFORE it, so a sandbox build exits non-zero having produced a correct feed; do not read the trailing traceback as a feed failure. And because bake_stats could not run, the `?v=` cache-bust literals in library.html / index.html / vault.html still read `20260930071024` and stats.json was not refreshed, so a returning visitor may serve the cached feed until the next full fleet build re-bakes it — flagged, not claimed as done. FLAGS: `synthesist/status.json` still stale at 2026-08-29 (32 days). CARRY FORWARD: (1) the guard list is not the coverage list — diff a rebuilt feed against the published one section by section before publishing anything, because a degraded run looks healthy in its own log; (2) `git reset --hard` reverts navigator/ACTIVITY.md and status.json AND deletes your new record files once they have been committed — recover with `git checkout <old-sha> -- <paths>` and re-verify the count on disk.
